description: verify_simple sets max_path_len = 1 + MAX_INTERMEDIATES = 3 in the ValidationPolicy passed to validate_path. MAX_INTERMEDIATES is 2, so verify_simple advertises allowing only 2 intermediates — but the policy allows 3. The shape check catches chains with >3 certs before validate_path is called, so the policy's PathTooLong guard never fires for the 3-intermediate case. If the shape check were ever removed or had an off-by-one, the policy would silently permit one extra intermediate that verify_simple claims to reject. Defense-in-depth is absent: the policy should say max_path_len = MAX_INTERMEDIATES = 2, not 3.
title: verify_simple passes max_path_len=3 but enforces max 2 intermediates
